title: Launch Distinctive: public site on Markus and the Papyrus newsroom CMS
description: Stand up Distinctive™ — Trademark News & Analysis as a Papyrus publication in the Anth.us shape: the stock Papyrus newsroom (@anthusai/papyrus, generic theme pack) as the CMS, and the public site as Markus pages projected to S3 behind CloudFront by web/projector.py. Design: the 'Distinctive™ — Trademark News & Analysis' canvas (home, ruling commentary, TTAB rulings tracker, the Wire, newsletter signup page, The Docket email, sponsor units, signup touchpoints).

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-10-21 shipped: dark mode, Lucide icons, one sponsor unit per page, honest sponsor copy, precedent-first rulings, page actions, share card and touch icon, favicon redirect, Papyrus 5.15.1, deploy on merge to main.
